name: rungic-firefox
description:
Firefox for Plasma Mobile on Android
mobile-config-firefox (touch UI), policies and preferences, and /usr/bin/firefox as a
wrapper that gives Firefox the private FFmpeg with Android hardware codecs (docs/48), and in an
agent workspace a profile of its own with a copy of the user's sign-ins. The packaged
/usr/bin/firefox is diverted to /usr/bin/firefox.rungic-orig.
